title: The Veteran's Barrow
text: Only those who once laid down their arms may enter this barrow. A broken sword is carved on its door, and the stone before it is worn by the knees of old soldiers. Inside, faintly, men are singing a marching song.

options.label: Someone who once laid down their arms goes in, as the door asks.

outcomes.text: The dead soldiers salute them and give up their captain's blade.

options.label: The strongest forces the door; the dead can sing elsewhere.

outcomes.text: The singing stops, and the dead do not salute.

options.label: Say the soldiers' prayer and go, leaving them to their song.

outcomes.text: A cold wind carries the marching song out to you. Then there is peace.
